title: LIVE WTA Finals 2026 | Elina Svitolina and Karolina Muchova have no room for error after opening defeats
text:
LIVE WTA Finals 2026 | Karolina Muchova takes first-set advantage as Svitolina struggles under pressure Skip to content Tournaments ▼ Newsletter FAQ Calendars ▼ Players ▼ Originals ▼ Live Scores LIVE WTA Finals 2026 | Karolina Muchova takes first-set advantage as Svitolina struggles under pressure
 WTA by Cristhián Avila Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 21:57 Follow us on Google! 0 Elina Svitolina and Karolina Muchova meet in a crucial Group Stage clash at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells, with both players looking to bounce back from opening-match defeats. Svitolina suffered a heavy loss to Mirra Andreeva, while Muchova was beaten by Aryna Sabalenka. With their semifinal hopes already under pressure, both need a victory to remain in contention for the last four. ARTICLE_IN_2

 mandoist 09-11-2026 Either Lena has a chronic internal ailment (i.e., colitis, enteritis, Crohn's, or some type of lower abdomen issue) -- or she is once again dealing with 'Vukovitis'.
Mental stress can indeed cause lower body pains. No matter... whatever is truly going on sucks. 
"Virus" excuse is getting a bit old -- and often -- at this point. 
 mandoist 09-11-2026 Ironically, Martina became a U.S. Citizen about the same time as the Orange Convicted Felon & Abuser was just beginning on his road to losing all Daddy's Millions!! 
 mandoist 09-11-2026 "Another fresh start is in the cards."
Thanks for the Humor!! I'm guessing this is the minimum one can do to keep all your sponsors hanging-on in perpetuity? 
 mandoist 08-11-2026 Vukov is doing this to Lena... AGAIN!!!!!
WTA's autonomous collective should be dismantled for allowing Vukov to re-emerge from his hand-slapping suspension. Just ask WTA employees how that's been going lately as they witness his continued verbal abuses.
Women's Pro Tennis should start over. 
 mandoist 08-11-2026 Can't help but suspect Vukov is back to his old self again.
Thank you, WTA. Perhaps you can give them a "Battling Couple of the Year Award 2026" ?? 
 Bel 08-11-2026 Wtf? Why is there no reason? And what about the men's? 
 mandoist 06-11-2026 One step by another step -- WTA continues to 'lose the plot'.
Too many hi-tech microphones being installed at most venues!!!
Remove them (especially those along the hallways, sidewalks, and pathways throughout the venues.
Not to mention (most of all) remove the mic's from the Players/Coaches Box. 
 mandoist 06-11-2026 Enough of her bullshit.
Go marry someone. 
 Rapunzel 05-11-2026 Don't you just love this young lady!? We fans often expect athletes to be supermen and superwomen, often forgetting that they WILL GET TIRED! I love Alex's perspective. Tiredness for an athlete should never be viewed as a negative, especially if you are healthy, taking care of your body and mental health and putting in the work. What a mature perspective. Good for you, Alex!
